ada: Morning — midweek headroom spotlight. quick check on fleet/provisioning across regions.
ada: Yesterday: drained 3 nodes in us-west1 for kernel rollout; saw a spike in spot evictions around 03:20 UTC. logging attached in #ops-logs.
ryan: Noted. blocker: provisioning job for eu-west-2 got stuck on instance allocation (ticket #1234).
priya: I pushed an autoscaler tweak last night to reduce aggressive terminations. might be related. can someone confirm current quota usage in ap-southeast-1? @leo
leo: ap-southeast-1 quotas are within limits but available GPUs are down ~12% due to scheduled maintenance on two racks. ops ticket out.
ada: Quick headroom snapshot: us-west1 +8% available, eu-west-2 -2% after the drain, ap-southeast-1 +1% (fragile).
ada: Asking for a short burst in eu-west-2 to cover the canary (target ~2k req/min for 30m). @ryan @priya  :please:
ryan: +1 — creating a temporary reserved bump, will log change and notify billing.
priya: If autoscaler stabilizes we'll avoid overcommit. leaving fallback route to gcp-eu-central if evictions surge.
leo: FYI infra-bot: request to scale eu-west-2 by 4 nodes for 30m
infra-bot: scale-up request accepted: job 6789 queued, ETA ~4m, source=manual_request
ada: Small action item: please review/approve PR #489 (node-drain script) — it includes a short eviction backoff.
ryan: Reviewing PR now.
priya: Heads-up — serving KV cache priming on the new binary caused memory to peak during rollout; watching memory OOM risk and GC churn.
leo: No SRE blockers beyond the maintenance window.
ryan: LGTM on #489, merging and scheduling the rollout in 2m. :thumbsup:
ada: I'll monitor tail latencies and CPU after merge. will post back in ~15.
ada: Update: tail latencies stable, small bump +30ms in eu-west-2 during scale-up window, error rates unchanged.
priya: Good to hear. closing ticket #1234 on provisioning side.
ada: thanks team — closing this check-in. ping here if anything regresses.
